name: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Finds the k most frequently occurring elements using a frequency map and bucket sort or min-heap.
aim: Count element frequencies, then extract k elements with highest counts using a min-heap of size k or bucket sort.
howItWorks: Use min-heap of size k: push elements, pop when size>k
Or use bucket sort: bucket[freq] stores elements with that frequency

time.bestCase: Heap approach: O(n) count + O(n log k) heap

alternatives: Sort by frequency — O(n log n) simpler
